map.总分 ≥85 为战略供应商（优先签长期协议）、≥70 优选、≥60 合格（限制份: A total of 85 or above makes a strategic supplier (sign a long-term agreement first), 70 or above preferred, 60 or above acceptable (limit the share and track improvement), and below 60 unacceptable (drop them and exclude them from the list). Penalties also apply: an asset-liability ratio above 70% deducts 10 points and no ISO certification (iso=1) deducts 10 points, which can drop the supplier a grade after deduction.
map.新供应商引入前，录入资质、财务、产能、质量、供货五大维度信息，自动算出准入总分并: Before onboarding a new supplier, enter information across five dimensions - qualifications, finance, capacity, quality and delivery - and the admission total is computed automatically with a verdict of strategic, preferred, acceptable or rejected.
map.资质=注册资本/产量系数+经营年限+资质等级+ISO 等级；财务=营收规模+负债: Qualifications = registered capital / output coefficient + years in business + qualification grade + ISO grade. Finance = revenue scale + debt ratio banding (<=30 -> 30 points, decreasing band by band to >85 -> 0) + credit rating. Capacity = capacity fulfilment rate bands (>=150% -> 40, capped) + equipment grade. Quality = pass rate mapping minus complaint deductions. Delivery = on-time rate + years of cooperation. Each item is capped at 100, then the mean of the five dimensions is taken and rounded.
map.输入供应商五大维度信息（资质/财务/产能/质量/供货），系统自动计算准入评分并分: Enter the five dimensions of supplier information (qualifications, finance, capacity, quality, delivery) and the system computes the admission score automatically, grading the supplier as strategic, preferred, acceptable or rejected.
map.：输入：注册资本 2000 万、经营 12 年、资质 4 级、ISO 4 级、营: : entered: registered capital 20 million CNY, 12 years in business, qualification grade 4, ISO grade 4, revenue 80 million CNY, asset-liability ratio 40%, credit grade 4, capacity fulfilment 160%, equipment grade 4, pass rate 99%, complaint rate 1%, on-time rate 97%, 6 years of cooperation. The five dimension scores are: qualifications 92, finance 87, capacity 88, quality 89.4, delivery 98.2; total = round((92+87+88+89.4+98.2) / 5) = 91, so a strategic supplier (85 or above). No penalties apply (debt ratio <= 70, ISO != 1). If instead the debt ratio is 75% and there is no ISO certification, 10 points are deducted twice and the total falls to 71, making it a preferred supplier.
